fnd-model: approx: java.net.URL/URI behaviour is approximated. A URL is accepted when its protocol is http, https, ftp, file, jar or mailto, and the trimmed original string is returned (Java does not normalise). Lenient parsing (sloppyLinkToStrictURLNoThrows) follows the source branches: blank gives http://; a known protocol keeps the string; an absolute URI with an unknown protocol gives http://; anything else gets http:// prepended. URI validity is a check for illegal characters and bad % escapes. linkHost/enclosureFilenameOf copy URI.getHost/getPath with regexes: a registry-based authority (e.g. a host containing _) gives a null host, the host is not lowercased, and an opaque URI gives a null filename.

fnd-net: structure: three files beyond the four target paths, all in core/net/. HttpMessages.ets holds the request/response/header/CacheControl/MediaType types and the interceptor contract; CacheStrategy.ets holds the pure cache logic; HttpCache.ets holds the disk cache. The split avoids circular imports and keeps each file under 600 lines. Consumers should import HttpRequest and HttpResponse from HttpMessages.ets, not HttpClient.ets.

fnd-net: approx (FS-A20 finalUrl): @kit.NetworkKit follows redirects itself and does not report the final URL. HttpResponse.finalUrl is a guess: if a final 2xx response (other than 201) still carries a location header, that value is resolved against the request URL; otherwise finalUrl is the request URL. With multi-hop relative redirects, or when NetworkKit clears headers between hops, finalUrl will be the original URL. Only the original URL is used as the cache key, whereas OkHttp caches each redirect hop.

fnd-net: policy (FS-A13): the User-Agent is 'SpaceCowboys HarmonyOS RSS Reader / <versionName>(<versionCode>)'. The ledger has the literal 'Android'; conventions §C says to replace the platform name with HarmonyOS. The version comes from bundleManager.getBundleInfoForSelfSync.

fnd-net: approx (FS-A17): in the source, TooManyRequestsInterceptor is a network interceptor, so its only-if-cached would only reach the server as a header (the explore doc rates this PLAUSIBLE). Here it sits above the cache layer, so during the window the request really is answered from cache, or gets 504 if nothing is cached, as the ledger intends. Only 429s that came from the network start the window. In the image client it runs after AlwaysUseCache/ImageOnlyOnWifi so they don't overwrite its cache-control.

fnd-net: policy (FS-A17/A18 hook): TooManyRequestsInterceptor does not call the setRetryAfterForFeedsWithBaseUrl hook. In the source only RssLocalSync calls repository.setRetryAfterForFeedsWithBaseUrl, using the max retry-after with a 3600 fallback, not the interceptor's 60. Calling it from the interceptor would wrongly delay feeds after image 429s. setRetryAfterForFeedsWithBaseUrlHook (registered by the repo) and setRetryAfterForFeedsWithBaseUrl(host, seconds) (called by sync) are exported for this.

fnd-net: policy (security): the source trusts all certificates (trustAllCerts plus hostnameVerifier always true). HttpClientConfig.trustAllCerts defaults to false, so the system validates certificates, because the explore doc flags this as an MITM risk needing a ruling. Setting it to true maps to remoteValidation 'skip'. Feeds with self-signed certificates will fail until this is decided.

fnd-net: approx: NetworkKit gives no reason phrase. HttpResponse.message comes from a status-line header key if one exists, otherwise from a standard phrase table, so HttpError descriptions may differ from the server's exact text.

fnd-net: approx (cache): OkHttp's Warning 110/113 headers are not added. A cached response's request field is the current request. Disk eviction uses in-memory last-access times seeded from file mtime. The cache key is a 64-bit cyrb53 hash with a URL check, so a collision counts as a miss.

fnd-net: approx (FS-A22): OneImageRequestPerHostInterceptor is applied in the images() chain and exposed as withLock(url, block). It covers only network fetches done through HttpClient.images(); unlike Coil it does not cover in-memory image cache hits, because there is no Coil pipeline. Its bucket formula (javaStringHashCode(host) % 8, can be negative) matches the source.
fnd-net: API naming: the DELETE convenience method is deleteRequest(), because 'delete' is a reserved word. maxResponseBytes is 100MB (NetworkKit's default is 5MB; 100MB is its cap).

fnd-net: fnd-app-init must call HttpClient.init(new FilePathProvider(ctx.cacheDir, ctx.filesDir)) at startup. Without it the main and image clients have no disk cache, so FS-A11/A16/A17/A21 caching does nothing.
fnd-net: fnd-app-init (owner of module.json5) must add the ohos.permission.INTERNET and ohos.permission.GET_NETWORK_INFO requestPermissions.

fnd-net: fnd-repo must register setRetryAfterForFeedsWithBaseUrlHook((host, retryAfterMs) => DAO UPDATE feeds SET retry_after=:t WHERE url LIKE '%'||:host||'%' AND retry_after < :t). fnd-sync-engine must call setRetryAfterForFeedsWithBaseUrl(feedHost, seconds) when NetworkHttpError.retryAfterSeconds or HttpResponse.retryAfterSeconds() is non-null (FS-A18). FeedFetcher must apply the FS-A19 content-type gate using HttpResponse.contentType(), with mimeType = contentType()?.toString().
fnd-net: Image loading code (fnd-html-render / fnd-feed-items) must load bytes via HttpClient.images().fetchImage(url) for FS-A21/A22 to apply; ArkUI Image(url) bypasses all of it.

fnd-html-dom: Parsing implements a subset of the HTML5 tree-building rules. It covers implied html/head/body, void elements, block tags implicitly closing p, li/dd/dt/heading auto-close, table fostering and implied tbody/tr, active formatting elements with a simplified adoption agency, raw text for script/style, RCDATA for title/textarea, and `<base href>`. fnd-sync-engine: approx (FS-A39): Java regex is translated to JS RegExp. Possessive quantifiers and atomic groups are approximated as greedy quantifiers and non-capturing groups. Inline flags in the middle of a pattern, the COMMENTS flag x, and Java-only classes such as \p{Alpha} / \p{javaLowerCase} fail to compile and are reported as InvalidRegex. The reason text comes from the JS engine, not Java's PatternSyntaxException description. For text over 100000 chars, lookarounds after the cut-off can see only the next 1024 chars, not the full text.

fnd-ui-theme: approx UC-A23/A24: variable-font axes are not expanded into separate font variants. Each font file is registered once; Text uses fontWeight(w, {enableVariableFontWeight: true}), and italic/slant is left to system synthesis. System default sans is the 'HarmonyOS Sans' family. System monospace/serif use the generic names 'monospace'/'serif', and whether the system maps them correctly is unverified. A user font file that is unreadable but has a valid header cannot be detected; rendering then falls back to the system font, not Roboto Flex.

fnd-ui-theme: approx UC-A39/A40: the custom pull-refresh state machine is replaced by ArkUI Refresh: refreshOffset 80vp = source RefreshThreshold, pullDownRatio 0.5 = DRAG_MULTIPLIER, default indicator. fnd-ui-theme: approx UC-A41: ArkUI Progress has no indeterminate linear mode, so a private IndeterminateLinearProgress animation replaces LinearProgressIndicator. fnd-ui-theme: approx UC-A43: ArkUI onVisibleAreaChange measures visibility against the clipped visible area (parent and window), not strictly the direct parent's bounds. VISIBILITY_RATIOS (0..1 in 0.01 steps) together with VisibilityTracker's at-least-1% change filter give the source's callback rule.

fnd-ui-theme: approx UC-A19: setWindowSystemBarProperties sets a transparent status bar, the status/nav icon colour per theme, and the source scrim colours on the nav bar. SYSTEM mode follows system dark mode through the applicationContext 'environment' callback. To make system components follow a forced DAY/NIGHT theme, ApplicationContext.setColorMode is called. When switching back from a forced mode to SYSTEM, the system's dark/light value is assumed equal to the previously forced mode until a configuration event corrects it, so it can be briefly wrong.

relationalStore API facts used, checked against the local SDK .d.ts: RdbStore.execute(sql, args) returns Promise<ValueType> (API 12+). createTransaction(options) returns a Transaction with querySql / execute / insert / commit / rollback. ValuesBucket is Record<string, ValueType>.
Kit imports used: deviceInfo from @kit.BasicServicesKit, cryptoFramework from @kit.CryptoArchitectureKit, util.Base64Helper from @kit.ArkTS.

For sibling units: AppDatabase.init(ctx) must finish before any DAO call, otherwise store() throws 'AppDatabase not initialized'. fnd-app-init owns that call (AppBootstrap: SettingsStore.init → AppDatabase.init).
For sibling units: inside AppDatabase.transaction(fn), always pass the tx argument to DAO calls. Calling a DAO write without tx inside fn waits on the write lock that fn already holds and deadlocks.
